items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Mary Lou recorded three numbers for Asch with seven musicians which included ... Eddie Robinson, bass ... and me.

ctx.x: We were doing one night stands and played Chicago, Indianapolis, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, St. Louis and some cities that I've forgotten as we were moving around so fast. The last performance was in New York city the 30th of October at Manhattan Centre. The show was a big success everywhere and Adam Clayton Powell Jr. made a speech at Manhattan Centre before the show started which put everybody in high gear. And Mr. Roosevelt won the election which made all of us feel as though we had a big hand in his Victory.

December 15th, 1944, Mary Lou recorded three numbers for Asch with seven musicians which included Coleman Hawkins, Claude Green, clarinet, Joe Evans, alto sax, Eddie Robinson, bass, Denzil Best on drums and me. Then there was another session with Jack (the Bear) Parker replacing
Best and Al Lucas in place of Robinson on bass.
